quantization.normals: Normalized source normals rounded to snorm8 XYZ, renormalized on GPU
quantization.linearPigment: Float16 RGB, same numerical storage precision as native captures
quantization.implicitAttributes: kind4, exposure.8, UV0; no geometry reduction

nativeFieldRecipe.scope: Maximum recorded prototype sampling/smoothing footprint, not a native appearance certificate.

source.claim: Original detailed native leaf triangles, MASK maps and area/pigment moments, at actual seated root transforms. No crown dome ranges.

transport.scope: Byte-exact attributes and index sequences, then deterministic gzip. No filters, index/vertex reordering or geometric change.

recipe.scale: Local area density divided by uniform root scale, so integrated leaf area scales with s squared
recipe.neighbors: Four conservative transformed native-field XZ block touches per root; 0xffffffff padding; 0xfffffffe missing block prevents full-tree suppression
recipe.assembly: ADD continuous leaf-area density and linear RGB area moments; one shared world lattice; no prethresholded tree unions or terrain colour
recipe.mesh: Lewiner marching cubes, original field isovalue, shared lattice; internal block boundaries are partitioned, never capped with extra foliage
